name: Okayama (Japan)
description: A violet field charged at the centre with the Okayama city emblem in white: an eight-pointed radiating device enclosing a ring and a stylised mountain mark, together stylising the characters of the city's name.

features.role: Okayama city emblem — an eight-pointed device stylising 岡 and 山
features.symbolism: stylises the kanji of Okayama ('hill' and 'mountain')
